If people ask you how to log in with Bamboo HR on mobile use these instructions below I saw a few tickets just come in and hopefully this helps you On the app please see the screenshots below:

1. Please enter your ArchKey Email

![undefined](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

2. Type in archkey

![undefined](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

3. Log in with Single Sign On

![undefined](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

4. Once you click on Log in with Single Sign On you will go through a process to login with your ArchKey email account and password. Once that is completed you will be in the BambooHR app.

5. You are in the Bamboo HR app

![undefined](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Thank you,
